## Download

- **OpenVideoSmartShare-Setup-….exe**: the installer (recommended). It installs for the
  current user without admin rights and, if needed, downloads and installs the .NET
  runtimes from Microsoft.
- **OpenVideoSmartShare.exe**: the portable version, nothing to install. It needs the
  [.NET 10 Desktop Runtime and the ASP.NET Core Runtime 10](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/10.0);
  if they are missing, it offers to download them when it starts.
- **SHA256SUMS.txt**: checksums of the two files.

Windows 10/11, 64-bit. See the [README](https://github.com/wergio/OpenVideoSmartShare#readme)
for features and details · [Code signing policy](https://github.com/wergio/OpenVideoSmartShare#code-signing-policy)
